stories.title: Airbus lands 100-aircraft order for jets built with Broughton wings
stories.summary: SMBC Aviation Capital has placed a firm order for 100 Airbus A320neo family aircraft. The order, made up of 65 A321neo and 35 A320neo jets, was finalised at the Farnborough International Airshow. Airbus Broughton, manufactures the wings for the A320 family. stories.title: Andy Burnham becomes prime minister, launches rough sleeping drive
stories.summary: Andy Burnham has become prime minister, succeeding Keir Starmer. He used his first speech outside 10 Downing Street to announce a national drive to end rough sleeping, backed by an additional £340 million in funding.
